checks: allocated uses actual Account .EVM with UInt256.ofNat credit. insertion_bound consumes funds_insert and Nat.mod_le, so wrapped credits cannot exceed input Nat credits.
Actual old balance removed by replacement is nonnegative; therefore address collisions/repetition do not invalidate the upper bound. No uniqueness or word-fit premise is needed.
populate consumes every generated address/credit pair recursively, inserting then recurring through the tail. populate_bound is universal over entries and initial world.
world starts empty and uses the complete GenesisFundingData.allocations, not a sample or precomputed total. initial_funds_le follows from populate_bound and empty map funds=0.
initial_funds_lt_96 consumes the kernel-certified total_credit_lt_96. No worldFunds<=totalCredit assumption is supplied as an input field.

Normative mainnet/reference selection, genesis state-root adoption, issuance and global funding histories remain open.
